+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import zipfile
+from itertools import product
+
+
+VERSION = "0.11.1"
+LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
+UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
+DIGITS = "0123456789"
+SYMBOLS = " !\"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~"
+LOWER_HEX = "0123456789abcdef"
+UPPER_HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF"
+
+
+HELP = """Find the password of protected ZIP files
+
+Usage: zip-password-finder.exe [OPTIONS] --inputFile <inputFile>
+
+Options:
+  -i, --inputFile <inputFile>
+          path to zip input file
+
+  -w, --workers <workers>
+          number of workers
+
+  -p, --passwordDictionary <passwordDictionary>
+          path to a password dictionary file
+
+  -c, --charset <charset>
+          charset to use to generate password
+          
+          [default: lud]
+
+      --charsetFile <charsetFile>
+          path to a charset file
+
+      --minPasswordLen <minPasswordLen>
+          minimum password length
+          
+          [default: 1]
+
+      --maxPasswordLen <maxPasswordLen>
+          maximum password length
+          
+          [default: 10]
+
+      --fileNumber <fileNumber>
+          file number in the zip archive
+          
+          [default: 0]
+
+  -s, --startingPassword <startingPassword>
+          password to start from
+
+  -m, --mask <mask>
+          mask pattern for mask attack (e.g. '?l?l?l?d?d' for 3 lowercase + 2 digits).
+          
+          Available tokens:
+            ?l  lowercase letters [a-z]
+            ?u  uppercase letters [A-Z]
+            ?d  digits [0-9]
+            ?s  symbols
+            ?a  all printable (?l?u?d?s)
+            ?h  lowercase hex [0-9a-f]
+            ?H  uppercase hex [0-9A-F]
+            ?1  custom charset 1 (--customCharset1)
+            ?2  custom charset 2 (--customCharset2)
+            ?3  custom charset 3 (--customCharset3)
+            ?4  custom charset 4 (--customCharset4)
+            ??  literal '?'
+          
+          Any other character is treated as a literal.
+
+  -1, --customCharset1 <customCharset1>
+          custom charset 1 for mask attack, referenced as ?1 (e.g. 'aeiou' or '?l?d')
+
+  -2, --customCharset2 <customCharset2>
+          custom charset 2 for mask attack, referenced as ?2
+
+  -3, --customCharset3 <customCharset3>
+          custom charset 3 for mask attack, referenced as ?3
+
+  -4, --customCharset4 <customCharset4>
+          custom charset 4 for mask attack, referenced as ?4
+
+  -h, --help
+          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
+
+  -V, --version
+          Print version"""
+
+
+class CliExit(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, code, stderr="", stdout=""):
+        self.code = code
+        self.stderr = stderr
+        self.stdout = stdout
+
+
+def red(s):
+    return "\x1b[31;1m" + s + "\x1b[0m"
+
+
+def clap_error(message, usage=None):
+    parts = [red("error: " + message), red("")]
+    if usage:
+        parts.append(red(usage))
+        parts.append(red(""))
+    parts.append(red("For more information, try '--help'."))
+    raise CliExit(2, "\n".join(parts) + "\n")
+
+
+def parse_usize(opt, value):
+    if value is None or value.startswith("-"):
+        clap_error(f"a value is required for '{opt} <{opt.lstrip('-')}>' but none was supplied")
+    try:
+        if value.startswith("+") or value.startswith("-"):
+            raise ValueError
+        return int(value, 10)
+    except Exception:
+        clap_error(f"invalid value '{value}' for '{opt} <{opt.lstrip('-')}>': invalid digit found in string")
+
+
+def parse_args(argv):
+    opts = {
+        "charset": "lud",
+        "minPasswordLen": 1,
+        "maxPasswordLen": 10,
+        "fileNumber": 0,
+        "workers": None,
+        "passwordDictionary": None,
+        "charsetFile": None,
+        "startingPassword": None,
+        "mask": None,
+        "custom": [None, None, None, None],
+        "inputFile": None,
+    }
+    longs = {
+        "--inputFile": "inputFile", "--workers": "workers", "--passwordDictionary": "passwordDictionary",
+        "--charset": "charset", "--charsetFile": "charsetFile", "--minPasswordLen": "minPasswordLen",
+        "--maxPasswordLen": "maxPasswordLen", "--fileNumber": "fileNumber", "--startingPassword": "startingPassword",
+        "--mask": "mask", "--customCharset1": "custom1", "--customCharset2": "custom2",
+        "--customCharset3": "custom3", "--customCharset4": "custom4",
+    }
+    shorts = {"-i": "inputFile", "-w": "workers", "-p": "passwordDictionary", "-c": "charset", "-s": "startingPassword", "-m": "mask", "-1": "custom1", "-2": "custom2", "-3": "custom3", "-4": "custom4"}
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        a = argv[i]
+        if a in ("-h", "--help"):
+            raise CliExit(0, stdout=HELP + "\n")
+        if a in ("-V", "--version"):
+            raise CliExit(0, stdout="zip-password-finder 0.11.1\n")
+        key = None
+        val = None
+        shown = a
+        if a.startswith("--") and "=" in a:
+            name, val = a.split("=", 1)
+            key = longs.get(name)
+            shown = name
+        elif a in longs:
+            key = longs[a]
+        elif a in shorts:
+            key = shorts[a]
+        else:
+            clap_error(f"unexpected argument '{a}' found", "Usage: zip-password-finder.exe [OPTIONS] --inputFile <inputFile>")
+        if val is None:
+            i += 1
+            if i >= len(argv):
+                clap_error(f"a value is required for '{shown} <{key}>' but none was supplied")
+            val = argv[i]
+        if key in ("workers", "minPasswordLen", "maxPasswordLen", "fileNumber"):
+            opts[key] = parse_usize(shown, val)
+        elif key and key.startswith("custom"):
+            opts["custom"][int(key[-1]) - 1] = val
+        else:
+            opts[key] = val
+        i += 1
+    if opts["inputFile"] is None:
+        msg = "the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --inputFile <inputFile>"
+        clap_error(msg, "Usage: zip-password-finder.exe --inputFile <inputFile>")
+    if not os.path.exists(opts["inputFile"]):
+        raise CliExit(1, red("CLI argument error - \"'inputFile' does not exist\"") + "\n")
+    return opts
+
+
+def preset_to_charset(s):
+    out = []
+    for ch in s:
+        if ch == "l": out += list(LOWER)
+        elif ch == "u": out += list(UPPER)
+        elif ch == "d": out += list(DIGITS)
+        elif ch == "s": out += list(SYMBOLS)
+        elif ch == "h": out += list(LOWER_HEX)
+        elif ch == "H": out += list(UPPER_HEX)
+        else: raise CliExit(1, red(f"CLI argument error - \"Invalid charset preset: {ch}\"") + "\n")
+    return out
+
+
+def charset_from_opts(opts):
+    if opts["charsetFile"]:
+        try:
+            with open(opts["charsetFile"], "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                line = f.readline()
+        except OSError as e:
+            raise CliExit(1, red(f"standard I/O error - {e}") + "\n")
+        chars = list(line.rstrip("\n\r"))
+    else:
+        chars = preset_to_charset(opts["charset"])
+    return sorted(set(chars))
+
+
+def parse_custom_charset(pattern):
+    return parse_mask(pattern, [None, None, None, None], custom_mode=True)[0]
+
+
+def parse_mask(pattern, custom, custom_mode=False):
+    custom_sets = []
+    if not custom_mode:
+        for c in custom:
+            custom_sets.append(parse_custom_charset(c) if c is not None else None)
+    tokens = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(pattern):
+        ch = pattern[i]
+        if ch == "?" and i + 1 < len(pattern):
+            t = pattern[i + 1]
+            if t == "l": tokens.append(list(LOWER))
+            elif t == "u": tokens.append(list(UPPER))
+            elif t == "d": tokens.append(list(DIGITS))
+            elif t == "s": tokens.append(list(SYMBOLS))
+            elif t == "a": tokens.append(list(LOWER + UPPER + DIGITS + SYMBOLS))
+            elif t == "h": tokens.append(list(LOWER_HEX))
+            elif t == "H": tokens.append(list(UPPER_HEX))
+            elif t == "?": tokens.append(["?"])
+            elif t in "1234" and not custom_mode:
+                cs = custom_sets[int(t) - 1]
+                if cs is None:
+                    raise CliExit(1, red(f"CLI argument error - \"Custom charset ?{t} used but not defined\"") + "\n")
+                tokens.append(cs)
+            else:
+                tokens.append([ch]); tokens.append([t])
+            i += 2
+        else:
+            tokens.append([ch])
+            i += 1
+    return tokens
+
+
+def gen_bruteforce(charset, min_len, max_len, start):
+    started = start is None
+    for n in range(min_len, max_len + 1):
+        for tup in product(charset, repeat=n):
+            pw = "".join(tup)
+            if not started:
+                if pw == start:
+                    started = True
+                else:
+                    continue
+            yield pw
+
+
+def gen_mask(tokens):
+    for tup in product(*tokens):
+        yield "".join(tup)
+
+
+def gen_dictionary(path):
+    try:
+        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            for line in f:
+                yield line.rstrip("\n\r")
+    except OSError as e:
+        raise CliExit(1, red(f"standard I/O error - {e}") + "\n")
+
+
+def validate_zip(path, file_number):
+    try:
+        zf = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
+        infos = zf.infolist()
+    except Exception as e:
+        raise CliExit(1, red(f"Invalid zip file error - {e}") + "\n")
+    if file_number >= len(infos):
+        raise CliExit(1, red(f"Invalid zip file error - invalid file number {file_number}, archive contains {len(infos)} files") + "\n")
+    idx = file_number
+    if not (infos[idx].flag_bits & 1):
+        first = next((i for i, inf in enumerate(infos) if inf.flag_bits & 1), None)
+        if first is None:
+            raise CliExit(1, red("Invalid zip file error - zip file does not contain any encrypted file") + "\n")
+        idx = first
+    return zf, infos[idx]
+
+
+def try_password(zf, info, password):
+    try:
+        with zf.open(info, "r", pwd=password.encode("utf-8")) as f:
+            while f.read(1024 * 64):
+                pass
+        return True
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+def format_elapsed_ns(ns):
+    if ns < 1000:
+        return f"{ns}ns"
+    us, ns = divmod(ns, 1000)
+    if us < 1000:
+        return f"{us}us {ns}ns"
+    ms, us = divmod(us, 1000)
+    if ms < 1000:
+        return f"{ms}ms {us}us {ns}ns"
+    sec, ms = divmod(ms, 1000)
+    return f"{sec}s {ms}ms {us}us {ns}ns"
+
+
+def run(argv):
+    opts = parse_args(argv)
+    zf, info = validate_zip(opts["inputFile"], opts["fileNumber"])
+    if opts["passwordDictionary"]:
+        passwords = gen_dictionary(opts["passwordDictionary"])
+    elif opts["mask"] is not None:
+        passwords = gen_mask(parse_mask(opts["mask"], opts["custom"]))
+    else:
+        passwords = gen_bruteforce(charset_from_opts(opts), opts["minPasswordLen"], opts["maxPasswordLen"], opts["startingPassword"])
+    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
+    found = None
+    for password in passwords:
+        if try_password(zf, info, password):
+            found = password
+            break
+    elapsed = format_elapsed_ns(time.perf_counter_ns() - start)
+    print(f"Time elapsed: {elapsed}")
+    if found is not None:
+        print(f"Password found:{found}")
+    else:
+        print("Password not found")
+
+
+def main():
+    try:
+        run(sys.argv[1:])
+        return 0
+    except CliExit as e:
+        if e.stdout:
+            sys.stdout.write(e.stdout)
+        if e.stderr:
+            sys.stderr.write(e.stderr)
+        return e.code
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
*** End Patch
